And the goal is to find out which framework can handle the most requests per second with lowest latency. In the second test, we'll add a posgress database and each application after receiving a post request with a JSON payload will parse the JSON and save that object in the Postgress database. In addition, we'll measure posgress CPU usage itself as well as the connection pool size maintained by each application. To run the test, I created EKS cluster with nodes dedicated for each application and I ran exactly two instances on each node to utilize all CPU cores which in this case are two and each instance is limited to one CPU.
